listing.name: Ratchet & Clank (2002, PS2) (RAC-RS)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, prepared rac-rs Windows game after upstream builds it from your supported Ratchet & Clank disc. Direct no-argument launch reads the generated play configuration; preserve the whole source/prepared installation, player data and update recovery.

steps.title: Prepare the exact disc upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete rac-rs copy/components you are independently permitted to use, with your own PS2 Ratchet & Clank PAL/Europe v1.00 SCES-50916 ISO (4,213,997,568 bytes, SHA1 B0DFBD8EAC0D84F173B6FC25D8A02A5FF22C652F) or USA v1.00 SCUS-97199 (4,214,095,872 bytes, SHA1 AEE9275384F739C9B24CD5DE6F7E200292DB7B01). Japan, Platinum and Greatest Hits are not accepted by those fingerprints. Finish Setup.cmd disc validation, local translation/build and settings upstream. Keep the original ISO at its configured location. No original, toolchain, helper, compiler or game is obtained or executed here.

steps.title: Keep the full prepared installation
steps.instruction: The inspected official 0.4.3 ZIP is a source/setup kit, not a prebuilt game executable. Its producer builds build/release/rac-rs.exe locally from the player’s disc and creates generated/play.cfg. Keep the complete resulting installation, generated/ and oracle/ support data, matching libraries and toolchain/recovery, not merely the generated EXE. Source setup and a finished existing native installation are distinct states; this guide applies only after that preparation succeeds.

steps.title: Attach the generated native game directly
steps.instruction: Select the existing build/release/rac-rs.exe from that prepared installation, use its full installation root as working directory and leave arguments empty. Review the intent and request Play separately. The native no-argument entry finds generated/play.cfg up the executable’s parent chain, reads its original ISO setting, derives required support/player paths and starts the normal retail-cold game in process. It does not require invented launcher environment. Do not attach Setup.cmd, Play.cmd, a compiler or the developer oracle. Complete an update prompt or rebuild outside the attached attempt first.

steps.title: Preserve player files and generated configuration
steps.instruction: Keep the complete player/ folder, especially card.bin and card.start1.bin/card.start2.bin safety copies, settings, mod data, logs and crash logs, plus generated/play.cfg, all configured original/source paths and any established external player root. PAL/USA compatibility and modified rosters/scripts are not established by a shared title. Script mods use the separate OmniLoader/Luau contract; keep active mods and texture packs independently. This guide performs no import, conversion, restore, backup or deletion.

steps.title: Keep external updates and permissions explicit
steps.instruction: Retain GPL-3.0-or-later and NOTICE.md, the separately scoped OpenRAC mod SDK, OmniLoader/Luau, renderer and component notices; they do not license the original game, third-party scripts or texture packs. Upstream setup/launcher owns downloads, updates and rebuilding, with its own recovery behavior. Quit normally, preserve independent recovery and review/relink changed generated executable bytes after replacement. Upstream full-game reports are not native/installed, campaign, hardware, mod-corpus, real-save or Supported acceptance here. Removing registration preserves external files; managed lifecycle operations remain unavailable.

warnings: This release is a setup/source kit. Attach only the already generated native game with its complete installation and play.cfg; upstream retains compilation/update ownership.
